 Plaquemine Post South Iberville Parish early voting includes three locations
 Michael Tortorich, Post South Updated Wed, November 18, 2026 at 3:06 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Iberville Parish early voting includes three locations Iberville Parish voters will be able to vote early at three locations prior to the Dec. 12 election.
 According to Iberville Parish Government the three early voting locations include:
 Iberville Parish Registrar of Voters Office, 58050 Meriam St., Plaquemine, from Nov. 28-Dec. 5 (excluding Sunday)
 St. Gabriel Community Center, 1400 Gordon Simon LeBlanc Dr., St. Gabriel, Nov. 28 and Nov. 30
 North Iberville Community Center, 75700 Rosedale Rd., Rosedale, Dec. 4 and Dec. 5
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Officials announced that each location will be open from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. on the scheduled dates.
 Voters can visit the Secretary of State's GeauxVote website or download the free Geaux Vote mobile app to find more information about voting, including where to vote on Election Day, view an individual ballot, locate voting districts and more.
 For more information, visit sos.la.gov/elections-voting .
